label: Benchmarking large language models for cell-free RNA diagnostic biomarker discovery.
summary: Large language models can synthesize biomedical knowledge, parse vast amounts of data, and generate code, positioning them as promising tools for biomarker discovery from high-throughput omics data. Here, we benchmark six models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google on plasma cell-free RNA datasets spanning three clinical cohorts: Kawasaki disease versus multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children, active tuberculosis versus symptomatic respiratory controls, and myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic…
